Loss report: gitlab -> drone
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/version job.outputs (Drone steps cannot pass values to other pipelines)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/version job.runner (only the platform has a Drone form; other runner labels are lost)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/version/step/version-step-1 step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/version job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
